THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
RUNWAY
073
STUDY 037
Black Tweed Set & Gold Chains
Rights check
Source: 24375.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, glossy, wavy black
hair and layered gold chain necklaces stands in a
full-length portrait. She wears a black tweed cropped
jacket with gold-trimmed edges and jeweled buttons,
over a matching black tweed A-line midi skirt with patch
pockets. She carries a small black leather bag and
wears black slingback heels. Her expression is calm
and composed. A pale gray studio backdrop with a dark
gray floor and soft even light. Palette of black, charcoal,
and gold. Elegant and classic, in the style of a luxury
tweed lookbook.
Elegant, classic, chic
WORKING NOTES
- The gold-trimmed tweed is the signature texture.
- Add 'full-length, head to toe' to keep the heels in frame.
Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the heels.
